data.title: Bangkok canals being drained ahead of more rain
data.description: Flood drainage is being sped up in eastern areas of Bangkok ahead of heavy rain forecast over several days later this week.

data.title: Rescuers spooked, 'dead' dog springs back to life
data.description: KAMPHAENG PHET - Rescuers were spooked when a dog they believed to be dead suddenly sprang back to life in the back of their truck, seen in a video that drew more than 4 million views overnight.

data.title: Pet lovers upset by PM's 'save humans first' flood directive
data.description: Animal lovers on social media are upset by Prime Minister Anutin Charvirakul's advice that people evacuating their flooded homes should initially leave their pets behind and focus on saving human lives first.

data.title: Toxic flood worries in industrial Prachin Buri
data.description: PRACHIN BURI - Flooding in this eastern industrial province has raised concerns beyond the natural disaster itself, centred on contaminants from factory waste mixing with floodwater and posing a risk to people's lives.

data.title: New deal for Nan, Luang Prabang
data.description: NAN: Nan and Luang Prabang have signed an agreement to strengthen cooperation in trade, investment, cultural heritage and tourism.

data.title: Chadchart rules out any severe flooding repeats
data.description: Flooding in the capital was gradually easing, with the city shifting its focus to recovery and draining the remaining water, Bangkok governor Chadchart Sittipunt said, ruling out a repeat of last week's severe flooding.

data.title: Compensation claims top 850k
data.description: The government is speeding up flood relief, with more than 850,000 people registered for compensation across 65 provinces and all 50 Bangkok districts.

data.title: Timor-Leste PM  to visit this week
data.description: Timor-Leste Prime Minister Kay Rala "Xanana" Gusmão will visit Thailand on Oct 9-10 for talks with Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on bilateral cooperation, security and trade.

data.title: Atchariya slams betting ring charges
data.description: Activist Atchariya Ruangrattanapong has denied all charges after police traced more than 40 million baht between his accounts and an online boxing betting network.

data.title: Panel calls MP Suchada and husband
data.description: People's Party (PP) MP Rangsiman Rome has called Bhumjaithai MP Suchada Zhang Thaensap and her husband to testify before a House committee on Wednesday over allegations involving online gambling and money laundering.

data.title: Govt defends 'sin tax' funding shake-up
data.description: The government has defended proposed changes to the funding of four state bodies, rejecting claims that they would lower alcohol and tobacco taxes or benefit producers.

data.title: Flood plans on ice over red tape
data.description: Nearly a decade after Thailand drew up a 500-billion-baht plan to overhaul its flood management system, most of the nine projects remain unfinished, with budget constraints and opposition to land expropriation slowing progress.

data.title: Flooding forces 50 health facilities to halt services
data.description: Flooding has affected 141 healthcare facilities in 18 provinces, forcing 50 to suspend services. A total of 319 roads have also been affected.

data.title: Flood diversion plan faces scrutiny
data.description: The 160-billion-baht Chai Nat–Pasak–Gulf of Thailand water-diversion project has come under renewed scrutiny after the cabinet approved the scheme, which the government says will reduce flood risks across the Chao Phraya Basin.

data.title: NGO urges Türkiye to end  raids on LGBTQ+ people
data.description: Apcom Foundation, a Thai-based rights group, has called on Türkiye to end a crackdown on LGBTQI+ people, health workers and civil society groups following more than 100 arrests since Sept 12.

data.title: Newin wishes PM 2 more terms
data.description: Bhumjaithai Party heavyweight Newin Chidchob wished Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul another two terms in office, or until he grew tired of the job, as he celebrated his 68th birthday in Buri Ram on Sunday.

data.title: University gifts 3,000 long-life meals to flood-hit communities
data.description: Prince of Songkla University (PSU) has delivered 3,000 boxes of ready-to-eat meals developed under its “Grab agro” brand to Silpakorn University, for distribution to people affected by the flooding.

data.title: Drainage slow, but no risk of fresh flooding, says Bangkok governor
data.description: The flood is draining slowly in eastern Bangkok, but the good news is forecasts indicate there is no immediate risk of fresh flooding from rain or the runoff-surge coming from the North, Bangkok Governor Chadchart Sittipunt said on Sunday.

data.title: Flooding in 27 provinces and Bangkok
data.description: Flooding continues to affect 27 provinces and Bangkok, impacting more than 1.17 million households nationwide, although water levels have begun receding in many areas, according to the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation.

data.title: 40km pursuit ends Chinese man's escape to Malaysia
data.description: Three Thais were arrested after a 40-kilometre-long police pursuit while trying to smuggle an illegal Chinese migrant from Cambodian through Thailand to Malaysia.

data.title: Flood warnings for several areas
data.description: A flood warning has been issued for provinces facing the Chao Phraya River, as well as Phetchaburi, Chachoengsao and southern provinces, due to accumulated water and forecast rain.
